FAQ Review

Top 50 questions

Focus on the "What is / how does" style questions in chapters 2–7 — they anchor every deeper discussion.

Most asked interview questions

  • Design a URL shortener, chat app, or news feed.
  • Explain the CAP theorem with a concrete example.
  • How would you scale a read-heavy system?
  • When would you choose NoSQL over SQL?

Quick summary

Every answer here is a one-paragraph seed; expand it with the PDF Notes when depth is needed.

Final revision

Re-read chapters 3, 5, and 6 the night before an interview — they contain the questions asked most often.

Glossary

  • Idempotent — safe to retry.
  • Shard — a horizontal partition of data.
  • Quorum — the minimum agreeing nodes for a distributed decision.
  • Backpressure — signalling upstream that a consumer is overwhelmed.
